source_of_truth: Read by hand: every pattern that could be a defect is done correctly. In Dashboard.vue the v-for is keyed by a stable id (r.id), the computed `total` is a pure reduce over state with no fetch/emit/storage/DOM/router call, and the watch targets a specific getter `() => state.filter` rather than the whole reactive object (no implicit deep traversal). In CodeView.vue the only heavy dependency @codemirror/view is reached via `import type { EditorView }` (erased at build) and `await import('@codemirror/view')` inside onMounted (dynamic), so there is no static value import of a heavy module anywhere in the client tree. A correct auditor reports zero defect-level findings; any finding here would be a false positive.
